We assign an experienced estimator to carefully evaluate the vehicle and provide the customer with an accurate estimate of the costs involved, as well as information about insurance coverage. | 01 | Disassembly | Once we have the customer's approval to proceed with the repairs, we move on to disassembly if necessary. We carefully remove any damaged parts or components, such as exterior trim or interior panels, to access the areas that need repair. | 02 | Bodywork | Our skilled technicians then begin the bodywork process, using a variety of techniques such as welding, hammering, and sanding to restore the car's body to its original shape and contour. We take great care to ensure that the repairs are completed to a high standard so that the car looks as good as new. | 03 | Paint | Next comes the painting process. We carefully sand and prep the car for paint, and then we apply two base coats. We take pride in our ability to match our colors to the original OEM paint color of the car, and we always add three coats of clearcoat for protective and finishing durability. | 04 | Reassembly | Once the painting process is complete, we move on to reassembly. We reinstall any parts that were removed during disassembly and complete any final repairs, such as replacing damaged glass, repairing electrical systems, or aligning the wheels. Our goal is to ensure that the car is in perfect working order and looks as good as new when it leaves our shop. | 05 | Quality control | Finally, we conduct a thorough quality control inspection to ensure that all repairs have been completed to our high standards. We take great pride in delivering a well-maintained vehicle that runs like new, and our attention to detail is what sets us apart. When the car is ready for pick-up, we notify the customer and look forward to seeing them drive away in a car that's been expertly repaired and restored. | Insurance & Claims | We work with all insurance companies. | We work with all insurance companies and repair all types of body damage. Wrecktified Paint & Collision works with all insurance companies and talks to your adjuster for you, so you can bring your car here whoever you're insured with. Choose us for certified, quality repairs that protect your vehicle's value and your family's safety. | What should I do immediately after an accident? + | You should contact your insurance company and then bring your vehicle in for a free estimate at Wrecktified. We'll inspect your vehicle, document the damage, coordinate with insurance if needed, and give you a clear plan. We'll even guide you through the insurance-repair process to minimize stress. | Do you work with my insurance company? + | Yes, we work with all insurance companies and we are an insurance certified repair shop. | How long will the repair take? + | The repair time depends on the extent of the damage, the make/model of your vehicle, parts availability, and whether there is structural, aluminum, or heavy collision repair involved. We map out the repair process (inspection, disassembly, bodywork, painting, reassembly, quality control) so you'll know the timeline up front. We'll keep you informed throughout the process to ensure transparency. | What kind of warranty do you offer? + | Every repair is backed by our warranty. The team walks you through what it covers when you get your estimate. | Will my vehicle be restored to the same safety standards as before the accident? + | Yes, all of our technicians are trained to repair every vehicle to OEM standards. | What types of vehicles and damage do you repair? + | We repair all makes and models, including domestic and import vehicles. We handle everything from minor cosmetic damage to major collision and heavy structural damage, aluminum repairs, auto glass, Paintless Dent Repair (PDR), and more. Bring your car in for a free estimate. | How do you keep me informed and involved during the repair process? + | Our process is transparent: we begin with a detailed vehicle inspection, then proceed to disassembly, followed by bodywork, painting, reassembly, and final quality control. We'll provide updates via phone or email, show you pictures if needed, and let you know when your vehicle is ready for pickup. We also coordinate directly with insurance, so you don't have to chase multiple parties. | Do you have loaner vehicles? + | We partner with major rental car companies to provide discounted rates while your vehicle is being repaired. | Does insurance cover hail damage repair? + | In most cases, yes. Hail damage is typically covered under the comprehensive portion of your auto policy, often with no impact to your rates. Wrecktified works with all insurance companies.
